caption: The drawing features a single figurine of a person riding a horse. The horse is depicted in a static, upright pose, facing slightly to the left, and is primarily colored in shades of gray with light brown outlining its features, including the mane, nostrils, mouth, and the contour of the legs. There is a single green circular decoration with a brown border hanging on the horse’s side, and brown lines suggest the presence of reins and a saddle. The rider is dressed in a red-brown garment with a green hood that covers the hair and part of the face, with minimal facial features indicated. The entire figurine stands on a rectangular base that is green on the sides with a brown trim above it. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with a thin, double-lined border framing the image. The artist’s signature, "MIMA LOWRY," appears in small letters at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Woman on Horse
